title: Center Stage Confidence: How to Own your Story and Command Any Room
description: You already have everything you need to succeed. This book shows you how to apply it with intention. Center Stage Confidence was written for professionals who are ready to stop holding themselves back. If you have ever gone silent in a meeting or lost your words in front of an audience, this book gives you the tools to claim your story, communicate with clarity, and pursue your goals with purpose. Justin Guarini has spent more than two decades performing under intense pressure. His experience ranges from the American Idol season one on stage in front of 30 million live Television viewers to seven leading roles on Broadway to co-founding Powerful Professionals, a coaching organization for entrepreneurs who want to scale beyond referrals and word of mouth. In these pages, he explains the mindset shifts and internal work that helped him, and thousands of others, replace hesitation with leadership. This book does not rely on tricks or inflated promises. It offers a path to real confidence that grows from understanding your identity and recognizing the value you bring.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_2"]', '#CardInstance-oyStmmt8cfexs7GRwY3FA')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_2',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);height:20px;margin-right:4px;width:20px}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_modal_spinner__3bz5K,._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_popover_inner__3tPIV{padding

title: Center Stage (Magnolia Steele Mystery Book 1)
description: A disgraced Broadway actress. A dead music agent. A hometown full of secrets. Magnolia Steele swore she’d never return to Franklin, Tennessee—not after the night everything changed and she fled with nothing but a suitcase and a head full of hazy memories. But when her Broadway debut implodes in scandal, Magnolia has no choice but to retreat home… to a town that’s been waiting for her return. Her first night back, she’s roped into helping her mother’s catering company at a swanky party for a country music star—only to come face-to-face with a sleazy agent from her past. When he turns up dead the next morning, all eyes turn to Magnolia. To clear her name, Magnolia must unravel more than just the murder. Because the deeper she digs, the more she realizes: the truth she forgot is the one that could destroy her. Perfect for fans of small-town mysteries with grit, wit, and a fierce Southern heroine. title: Center Stage: A Steamy Reverse Age Gap Romance
description: Emmie came to Puerto Vallarta to reinvent herself. Falling for her co-star was not part of the plan. After a gutting divorce, Emmie leaves everything behind for the one dream she put on hold—a life on stage in the most beautiful city in Mexico. She’s done being careful. Done being small. What she isn’t done with, apparently, is being weak for her new co-star. Alejandro is the local heartthrob every woman wants and no woman keeps—charming, magnetic, and exactly the kind of trouble Emmie can’t afford. So they make a rule: no labels, no promises, no falling. Alejandro doesn’t do promises. Then Emmie walks in and rewrites all his rules. They are spectacularly bad at keeping their own agreement. Because Alejandro has never wanted to stay—until her. And Emmie has never wanted to trust again—until him. But Alejandro was burned once before, and when Emmie’s ex resurfaces claiming they’re still legally married, he doesn’t stop to ask if it’s true. He just retreats. Now Emmie has to decide: fight for a man who just proved he’ll run at the first sign of trouble, or protect the parts of herself she just started to reclaim. Some stages change your life. This one might just give her a second act. Center Stage is a steamy, dual-POV contemporary standalone romance set against the sun-soaked stages of Puerto Vallarta, Mexico—perfect for readers who love sizzling chemistry, complicated second chances, younger heroes, and women brave enough to start over.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_2"]', '#CardInstanceqjIUaAewzvwBMnU_u3CHTg')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_2',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-nor

title: Center Stage (The Keller Family Series Book 4)
description: John Forrester is a simple man whose never needed more than his work, his truck, and a small apartment with his flat screen TV. After a bad breakup with his ex-wife, John swore he’d never get married again and has done his best to keep to himself. But one woman always creeps into his mind—Arianna Keller. Arianna Keller had an amazing career, center stage on Broadway. However, her run in New York is over and circumstances have forced her back home to Nashville, Tennessee. The relationship John and Arianna have forged over the years as friends has always had a romantic spark, which has been ignored. Now they are working together to restore an old theater and their desire for each other can no longer be denied. It’s only a matter of time before sparks ignite into a passionate fire. But Arianna is keeping a secret which threatens to destroy more than her relationship with John—it threatens the lives of the entire Keller family.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_1"]', '#CardInstancewEScpezmPyfXeUbYurr0xw')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_1',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);height:20px;margin-right:4px;width:20px}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_modal_spinner__3bz5K,._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_popover_inner__3tPIV{padding:20px 24px 0;width:65vw}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_modal_spinner__3bz5K{height:15vh;margin-top:10vh;text-align:center}._tell-amazo

title: Center Stage (The Fangirl Series Book 3)
description: Relationships aren’t easy … especially when they're played out center stage. Small-town author, Kallie Reagan, is living her ultimate fantasy-come-true. Why? Because Niles Russell, the very rock star who inspired the hero of her wildly popular romance novel, is now her one-and-only. And their storybook relationship has their fans—and publicity teams—going wild. For this super-couple, life couldn’t possibly get any better. But it could get trickier. Because famous or not, crapstorms have a way of coming at you. And no amount of money, celeb-power, or public adoration can keep things like insecurities, troubled family members, and mismatched timelines and expectations from getting all up in your dream life. But when your soul mate's by your side, everything just falls into place. Right? Or is happily-ever-after just a myth reserved for the CHARACTERS of romance novels ... and NOT for their authors? CENTER STAGE is Book 3 in The Fangirl Series. Grab your copy now to catch up with the whirlwind lives of Kallie and Niles ... and every fangirl's fantasy-come-true. title: Center Stage: Media and the Performance of American Politics (Communication, Media, and Po
description: This up-to-date and lively text focuses on a wide range of issues, such as politics as theater, the economic forces shaping contemporary political media, the rhetoric of the 'War on Terrorism,' and the growth of new media. Separate chapters explore a range of contexts, including the presidency, Congress and the courts, foreign news reporting, and political art. The text concludes with ways to open up additional pathways for imagining our national life, ranging from Internet-supported activism to innovative uses of documentary film. Center Stage: Media and the Performance of American Politics examines political and mediated communication as forms of representational theater. Taking the dramatic orientation to politics seriously, Woodward explores how American civic culture is variously enriched and diminished by the ways practitioners and journalists organize narratives, or stories, about our civic life.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_0"]', '#CardInstanceK_LdapqckyxZyyFf71W4Qw')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_0',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);height:20px;margin-right:4px;width:20px}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_modal_spinner__3bz5K,._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_popover_inner__3tPIV{padding:20px 24px 0;width:65vw}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_modal_spinner__3bz5K{height:15vh;margin-top:10vh;text-align:center}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_

title: Center Stage (TNT Force Cheer Book 3)
cats: Teen & Young Adult Sports Fiction eBooks
description: Although Max Turner has been cheerleading for less than a year, she is a rising star at TNT Force, an all star cheer gym in Texas. In just a few months she has proven her skill level to the coaches and fellow athletes every time she steps foot inside the gym or on the competition mat. So, when a new cheer season begin, no one is surprised when Max is placed on a high level senior team. But, Max quickly begins to feel the pressure of her new squad. Faced with learning harder cheerleading stunts, getting to know a team full of athletes older than her, and working with a new coach is a lot to take in. Even for a fast learner like Max. And, as if that is not enough for her to deal with, it quickly becomes clear that someone at the gym is not happy about Max’s spot on the high level team. With the heat and stress of summer and hard conditioning pressing down on her, Max is beginning to question if she is really ready to be on a senior team at all. Without her best friend Lexi and Halley on the mat for support, every day of practice is becoming more and more trying for the 13 year old athlete. Knowing the world will soon be watching when the competition season begins, Max has to decide quickly if she has what it takes to be the cheerleading star everyone is expecting her to be.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_1"]', '#CardInstanceCvteBmgflPlZm6xaZOrTuA')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_1',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-eff
